decisions.reason: The general instruction to review and improve model credibility does not change the existing reference basis, provisional-input policy, or assumption-disclosure rules.
The source establishes a general credibility standard but neither changes the AUD and 2031 model basis nor resolves the existing CAD-versus-AUD ambiguity.
The source does not alter the required availability-payment demonstration, user-fee conclusion, or evidence standard established by the immediately preceding client message.
The general model-review instruction does not change the required equity IRR output or its 16–20% target range.
The source does not revise the selected opex range, network scope, provisional status, or exclusion of the Business Case Appendix figure.
The instruction to review the model thoroughly does not specifically change the debt schedule or DSCR coverage output.
The source does not replace or modify the provisional 55/45 single-tranche financing structure, approximate rate, or mezzanine exclusion.
The broad review authorization does not change the twelve-site structure, authoritative Business Case site list, typologies, or treatment of missing site-level data.
The source does not change the required program-wide cost categories or their presentation as separate capex line items.
The source does not alter the asset-appropriate CCA treatment, example classes, tax-shield modeling, or equity-return effects.
The source does not change the requirement to compare the user-funded and availability-payment PPP scenarios.
The source does not modify the identified revenue streams or the requirement to model each stream separately.
